title: Container Bookings: service contract shortfall condition for goodwill on a customer roll fee
content:
## Rule
For a Container Bookings booking rated under a service contract, a goodwill waiver of a customer roll fee is granted only when the unpaid shortfall balance of that service contract is exactly 0.00, because goodwill is not extended while the contract holder owes an unpaid minimum-quantity shortfall. A booking with no service contract is not subject to the contract condition.

The shortfall balance is read from the record of the service contract the booking is rated under.

## Truth table (hypothetical balances)
| Booking rated under a service contract | Unpaid shortfall balance of that contract | Contract condition |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 0.00 | met |
| yes | 0.01 or more | not met |
| no | not applicable | not subject to the condition |

## Points of judgement
**The customer says the shortfall invoice is being disputed.** The condition looks only at whether the unpaid shortfall balance is exactly 0.00.
